It's all possible at Brightlands Incubators Maastricht.
Anyone looking for work space on the campus can contact the Brightlands Incubators Maastricht team, which is also based at Brightlands Maastricht Health Campus.
Oxfordlaan 70 Office space Meeting rooms The current tenant base is very diverse.

The Brightlands Incubators Maastricht team knows how important it is to have a suitable and pleasant workplace.
As a result, a number of renowned research institutes , many medical startups, and renowned companies in healthcare and life sciences are located in the vicinity.
